recirculating.heroIntro: Ideal where direct external discharge is challenging. Deltatec configures multi-stage filtration and airflow balancing to support cleaner indoor operation.

energy.heroIntro: Rebuilt from the original energy-monitoring concept with modern UX, this service focuses on variable speed extraction, telemetry and alert-led maintenance.

extractor.heroIntro: Designed for high pressure drops, grease-heavy duty cycles and acoustic sensitivity. We match fan curves to the full worst-case system condition.

canopy.heroIntro: Canopy designs engineered for robust plume capture, practical cleaning access and integration with control and monitoring systems.

ozone.heroIntro: Deltatec ozone injection systems are engineered as controlled treatment stages to support odour management and microbial load reduction within suitable ventilation strategies.
